title: Built to Scale: How to Grow Embedded Payments Without Starting Over
summary:
Embedded payments can be relatively straightforward to launch, but successful growth changes what businesses need from their payments infrastructure. As volume rises, so can fraud exposure, compliance demands and operational complexity. Companies that design for those demands from the beginning, including by choosing providers equipped to support them through growth, can scale without having to rebuild payments along the way.
